name: Ventriloquism
body:
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 365
School illusion (figment); Level arcanist 1, bard 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, redmantisassassin 1, skald 1, sorcerer 1, spiritualist 1, summoner 1, summoner (unchained) 1, wizard 1
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, F (parchment rolled into cone)
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect intelligible sound, usually speech
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will disbelief (if interacted with); Spell Resistance no
Description
You can make your voice (or any sound that you can normally make vocally) seem to issue from someplace else. You can speak in any language you know. With respect to such voices and sounds, anyone who hears the sound and rolls a successful save recognizes it as illusory (but still hears it).
